subject: Temporary P1/P2 handoff & escalation ladder authorization (FinTrax)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary P1/P2 handoff & escalation ladder authorization (FinTrax)

Hi Marissa / Naomi —

Quick summary: FinTrax (linked deal DL-49217) is asking for confirmation that we'll hold through their peak weekend (maintenance window Saturday night) while we have a short on-call headcount gap. Two of our regular night responders are out (approved leave) for 5/15–5/21 which overlaps their post-deploy window.

Risk: If we don't authorize a controlled temporary adjustment we either: a) risk missed P2 responses overnight, or b) pull senior SREs into a sustained night rotation. Both undesirable.

Proposal (temporary, requested window 2027-05-15 to 2027-05-22):
- P1 responses unchanged (immediate owner + SRE emergency pager escalation).
- P2 overnight (00:00–07:00 PT) moved to a 90-minute acknowledgement window for the week; daytime P2 unaffected.
- We will assign a remote standby (Rishi) as secondary on-call for P1 escalations.
- CS will notify FinTrax and offer a one-time SLA goodwill credit if we miss an SLA during the window.

Conditions:
- This is an exception limited to the dates above.
- We run the attached runbook and share the handoff checklist with FinTrax ops.
- Escalation ladder must be explicit and tested (see runbook link).

Ask: Please approve the temporary P2 handoff window and confirm the escalation ladder below (or suggest changes). If approved, I'll loop in Evelyn (CS) to send the external notice and HubSpot update.

Attachments: oncall_gap_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), fintrax_maintenance_window.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC-example-runbook

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Support Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary P1/P2 handoff & escalation ladder authorization (FinTrax)

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear proposal. High level I support a constrained approach vs. pulling senior SREs into extended night coverage. A couple of requests before I sign off: 

1) Explicit escalation ladder for P1 and P2 (names, phone/pager, and a 2-hour fallback contact).
2) A one-page external note draft that Evelyn can send to FinTrax (we want transparency and to avoid surprises).
3) Confirmation that runbook walk-through was done with the SRE on call this week (Rishi can confirm).

If those three boxes are checked I can approve the exception for the 5/15–5/22 window. Please add Evelyn on the thread once the external note is ready — she'll handle the customer comms and the HubSpot update for DL-49217.

-Marissa
VP, Customer Success (interim)
From: Jordan Lewis <support@fintrax.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 07:48:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Temporary P1/P2 handoff & escalation ladder authorization (FinTrax)

Karthik / Evelyn —

Appreciate the heads up. We're fine with a temporary extended P2 ack window as long as:
- P1s are routed immediately to an on-call who can start mitigation within 15 minutes
- We get a single point of contact and a 24/7 escalation phone number for the week

Also: if an SLA is missed during your exception window we'd like to discuss a small service credit. Not a blocker — just want it on record so Finance/Procurement sees it.

Jordan Lewis
Head of Platform Reliability, FinTrax
support@fintrax.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary P1/P2 handoff & escalation ladder authorization (FinTrax)

All —

Approved with conditions: I authorize the temporary exception for the dates 2027-05-15 through 2027-05-22 under the following constraints:

- P1 handling unchanged: Primary on-call must acknowledge within 15 minutes and provide incident mitigation steps within 30 minutes. SRE emergency pager will be live as fallback.
- P2 overnight (00:00–07:00 PT) acknowledgment extended to 90 minutes for the date window only. Daytime P2 window stays at standard targets.
- Rishi will be the named secondary responder for P1 (contact: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, pager: +1-650-555-0199).
- Evelyn to send the external customer note and record action in HubSpot (HubSpot-39284).
- Any SLA miss during the window will be handled per our credits policy; coordinate with Finance & CS for the credit.

Please confirm you have shared the runbook with FinTrax and that the SRE on duty has signed off on the playbook. Once confirmed I'll mark DL-49217 as approved for the temporary exception.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Reliability
Redwood Inference
